svg.title: Drasi AI observability demo solution
svg.desc: Customer support and background workloads share an AI gateway and constrained model endpoints. OTel, Prometheus, Grafana and Langfuse observe behavior. Drasi combines selected signals with PostgreSQL changes, evaluates policy, allocation and resilience, and publishes versioned candidate plans. An operator approves a plan; a separate controller revalidates it before changing gateway configuration. Fresh observations confirm recovery.
svg.text: Keep the customer assistant working when AI capacity is constrained
Proposed Ignite demo | Traditional observability + AI traces + continuously maintained Drasi models
AI traces, tool calls, latency, cost and outcome scores
Customer / data policies and approved endpoints
Workload priority, quotas, budgets and demand
Result queries: live decisions, evidence, risks and candidate plans
OTel telemetry from the application and gateway
Bootstrap + CDC; no repeated full-state polling
RECOVERY: a saved plan is not success. Fresh telemetry and task outcomes must confirm that service has recovered.
Local demo: containerized services; endpoint mocks simulate logical regions, capacity and faults. No real GPU relocation.
Solid arrows: requests / observations / model inputs. Dashed arrows: assessments and approved control. Feasibility is model-based.
